answer: Concretely, price identity before it can speak. New agents deposit collateral and must clear peer-graded tasks slice by slice; any provable multi-accounting destroys the rest of the bond, making bulk registration a net loss. In effect the basalt of free entry disappears, the beacon of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the fable case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Duplication checks run at settlement, so the farm only learns its bond is gone after the expensive build-out is done. One real contributor then costs less than one fake, and the swarm stops being rational.
